title: Record format version 2
description: Target storage representation. A record without schema_version is a version 1 record and is decoded by the version 1 decoder; it is not valid against this schema. Field names in payload are application-defined.

schema_version.description: Format discriminator. Its absence means a version 1 record; any other value is an unsupported version, never a version 1 fallback.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC. Derived from the version 1 integer timestamp.

tags.description: Optional. Version 1 carried at most one tag string; the decoder wraps it in a list.

payload.description: Application data, preserved from the version 1 body with the same JSON value.
